label: Knowledge, justification, knowledge of justification, and certainty
term: knowledge, justification, knowledge of justification, and certainty
resolution: Knows F p w is first-order relational knowledge of p; justified w records justification of that same p; Knows F justified w is knowledge that p is justified. Negating the last does not negate either earlier condition without additional assumptions. The finite model establishes this distinction even with factivity and a global knowledge-requires-justification norm. Certainty is not modeled and no claim about its necessity for knowledge follows. The existing generic factivity profile and this relational realization are compatible but distinct interfaces; assertion does not supply any knowledge token. No causal or metaphysical grounding edge is an epistemic warrant edge.
